klaim.bukti: A linear model was obtained between the ground truth and the detected number with a coefficient of determination (R2) of 0.886 and a root mean square error (RMSE) of 1.484.
klaim.catatan: R2 0,886 berlaku untuk gabungan empat kultivar (104 sampel cabang, jumlah beri per cabang, Mask R-CNN); jumlah terdeteksi cenderung lebih rendah daripada hitungan manual.

klaim.bukti: We analyze 52 key studies and introduce a framework to guide method selection. This framework connects agronomic targets to detection, segmentation, or regression approaches based on their specific characteristics.
klaim.catatan: Cakupan, sumbu pengorganisasian, dan jumlah 52 kajian sesuai abstrak. Sel terakhir (No) adalah penilaian tinjauan sendiri; abstrak tidak menyebut identitas lintas pandang, teks lengkap tidak diperiksa.

klaim.bukti: The different methods were then compared in terms of the types of sample data used, sensor modalities, and types of classifiers used with a particular focus on the feasibility of each method for on-field application.
klaim.catatan: Tinjauan disusun menurut metode pengindraan kematangan (Seksi 2.1.1 sampai 2.2).

klaim.catatan: Seksi 3.4 merinci: colour vision sensing dengan CNN classifier.

klaim.bukti: From the 51 papers reviewed, which include a total of 11 unique approaches, it was found that the most feasible method for detecting ripe FFBs in the field is a combination of computer vision and deep learning.
klaim.catatan: Angka 51 sesuai abstrak, tetapi sumber tidak konsisten: Seksi 3 (h. 7) menulis 'A total of 48 articles were studied in this review'. Label systematic berasal dari judul; pencarian hanya Google Scholar tanpa diagram PRISMA. Sel terakhir (No) adalah penilaian tinjauan sendiri; teks tidak membahas identitas lintas pandang.

klaim.bukti: This pipeline processes UAV video by first using YOLOv8n to detect all palm trees within a frame, then passing these detections to DeepSORT, which assigns a unique and persistent ID to each individual tree.
klaim.catatan: Objek yang dihitung adalah pohon sawit, bukan tandan; data berupa video UAV dengan bingkai yang tumpang-tindih.

klaim.bukti: The paper also summarizes the sensors and systems developed and used by researchers to localize fruit as well as the potential and limitations of those systems.
klaim.catatan: Judul dan abstrak menunjukkan pengorganisasian menurut sensor dan sistem.

klaim.bukti: This paper reviews the research and development of machine vision systems for fruit detection and localization for robotic harvesting and/or crop-load estimation of specialty tree crops including apples, pears, and citrus.
klaim.catatan: Cakupan dan sumbu sesuai abstrak. Abstrak tidak menyebut jumlah kajian, selaras dengan 'Not stated', tetapi teks lengkap tidak diperiksa. Sel terakhir (No) adalah penilaian tinjauan sendiri.
